Welcome to the official experience of BEYBLADE X!
⚔️Play BEYBLADE X with your rivals! 

📢Oct 15, 2026: Beta 13.0 Update
🎁BEY Part Gifting added!
🤝Gift parts you own 2+ of to friends!
➡Approach a player and press GIFT.
➡Send up to 3 parts at once!
✨You can now buy multiple copies of BEYs!
➡Help newer friends by gifting!
*Roblox restrictions may limit gifting Robux-purchasable BEYs by age or region.

This game is currently in beta version.
📝Please share your thoughts and requests through forum.
👍Please like and favorite to support updates.

⚔️1v1 Battle Rules
1v1: 4 PT first.
2v2: 5 PT first.
Spin: 1 PT
Burst: 2 PT
Over: 2 PT
Extreme: 3 PT

⚔️Type Skills
💥SMASH (Attack)
🔥BOOST (Balance)
💫PARRY (Stamina)
🛡️COUNTER (Defense)

⚔️X-Skills
⚙Tackle [Default]
⚙Gordias[BB-06]
⚙B4 [BB-07]
⚙Rainbow [BB-08]
⚙Zodiac [BB-09]
⚙ Misleaders [BB-10]
⚙ Albatross [BB-11]
⚙ Phalanx [BB-12]
※X-Skills ⚙ can be obtained by opening 15 eligible Packs 🛍
